body.purpose: Interface text, channel names, descriptive copy.

label.purpose: Captions, channel groups, status labels, small data.

mono.purpose: Code-ish data such as playlist sources and technical labels.

shadows.name: state-lift
shadows.purpose: Glass panels and hovered surfaces — temporary elevation on interaction.

shadows.name: selection-lift
shadows.purpose: Selected channel list item — color-tinted depth confirming the active choice.

shadows.name: button-soft
shadows.purpose: Subtle button lift at rest in light mode.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Broadcast Red fill, white text, hover darkens to 80% opacity, focus shows a 3px red ring at 50% opacity.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; shrink: 0; items-center: true; justify-center: true; border-radius: 10px; border: none; background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; height: 2rem; padding: 0 10px; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action. Transparent fill, ink text, muted hover background, focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; shrink: 0; items-center: true; justify-center: true; border-radius: 10px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #090b0e; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; height: 2rem; padding: 0 10px; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: #090b0e; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Channel List Item
components.description: Signature row: scannable channel entry with avatar, name, group, and status dot. Dense (10px padding), 10px radius, flat at rest, lifts with red-tinted shadow when selected.
components.html:
AB
BBC One
General
components.css: .ds-channel-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); color: #090b0e; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-channel-item:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-channel-item[aria-pressed="true"], .ds-channel-item.selected { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-avatar { width: 8px; height: 8px; min-width: 32px; min-height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; background: #f1f5f9; color: #64748b; flex-shrink: 0; overflow: hidden; } .ds-avatar.selected { background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; } .ds-meta { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #090b0e; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-group { font-size: 9px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 2px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: 8px; } .ds-status-working { background: #10b981; } .ds-status-failed { background: #f43f5e; } .ds-status-testing { background: #fbbf24; animation: pulse 3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } .ds-status-untested { background: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.3); }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: 8px circular status indicator: working emerald, failed rose, testing pulsing amber, untested muted.
components.css: .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-working { background: #10b981; } .ds-status-failed { background: #f43f5e; } .ds-status-testing { background: #fbbf24; animation: pulse 3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } .ds-status-untested { background: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.3); }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Sticky top bar: logo left, source link and theme toggle right. Blurred background, subtle bottom border, responsive padding.
components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; height: 56px; background: rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8); } .ds-header-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; height: 100%; } .ds-header-inner @media (min-width: 640px) { padding: 0 24px; } .ds-header-inner @media (min-width: 1024px) { padding: 0 32px; } .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 14px; border: none; background: #ffffff; color: #64748b; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: #090b0e; border-color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Backdrop-blur overlay panel with semi-transparent background and hairline border; sits over content without obscuring it.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; }

narrative.overview: LiveTVFree is a dispatch-style dashboard for live TV: quick status scanning, signal clarity, and an instrument-panel feel. The visitor opens the app to find a channel worth watching across sports, news, and entertainment, and their job is to locate a stream that actually plays without wasting time on dead links. The visual system treats every screen like a control surface — dense enough to scan many channels at once, but with enough breathing room that a single "working" signal jumps out. Personality is deliberate and utilitarian with a confident accent: near-black text on a misty slate field, crisp borders, and Broadcast Red reserved for interactivity and status. Dark mode inverts to a deep charcoal field with paper surfaces, keeping the same red accent so the instrument panel reads identically in both themes. Motion is minimal and purposeful (status-dot pulses, soft hover lifts), never decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Dispatch dashboard density: many channels scannable at once, one playable signal easy to spot.
Broadcast Red as the single accent for buttons, focus rings, selection, and status.
Flat-by-default surfaces; shadows and lifts appear only as a response to state (hover, selection, focus).
Dark mode as a first-class theme, not an afterthought; red accent holds constant across both.
Responsive shell: sticky rail on phones, rail-plus-sidebar on desktop.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Broadcast Red is the sole saturated accent on any given screen. Its rarity is the point: if everything shouts, no signal lands.

rules.name: The Small-Text Rule
rules.body: Captions and group labels sit at 0.8rem / text-xs with 500 weight — small but never light. If it's hard to read at a glance, it's too small or too thin.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus, selection). Never use shadow to separate content that color and border can separate.

dos: Do use Broadcast Red (#ef4444) as the only saturated accent; keep it rare so the signal lands (One Voice Rule).
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; add shadow/lift only on hover, selection, or focus (Flat-By-Default Rule).
Do render status dots at exactly 8px with the working/failed/testing/untested color mapping; never reuse those colors for non-status elements.
Do keep channel rows at 10px padding with truncating two-line text so many channels stay scannable.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated hue (blue, green, purple) as a brand accent; emerald/rose/amber exist only for status dots.
Don't set a centralized heading scale in globals.css and then ignore it — if you add one, apply it consistently across Display / Headline / Title.
Don't drop shadows beneath unselected cards to fake depth; use border and background layering instead.
Don't make channel rows taller than the 10px-padded baseline unless a new information tier is justified.
